changes.summary: Keep low-level window mechanisms in C and desktop policy in zl until the language/runtime can own the required structures safely.
changes.rationale: The current kernel zl subset cannot express the required window list and mechanism boundary.
changes.compatibility: No public ABI change; preserve the current C/zl boundary until the replacement language/runtime contract is proved.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Enforce clipping in all five back-buffer write paths by folding the scissor into loop bounds.
changes.rationale: Measured escape pixels refuted the two-function boundary without adding a per-pixel hot-path branch.
changes.compatibility: Rendering output must retain the five-path clipping oracle at every supported mode.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Retire snapshot-and-sticker window dragging after damage repaint is authoritative; retain only cursor save-under.
changes.rationale: The old path imposed a window-size ceiling, artifacts and fixed memory cost.
changes.compatibility: Keep the existing drag fallback until retained damage repaint passes equivalent host and target gates.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Do not port a Linux-scale GPU stack; implement bounded native mechanisms while borrowing public hardware knowledge, not donor code.
changes.rationale: A complete i915/Mesa stack assumes kernel facilities outside zlOS, but bounded display/blitter providers remain valid product work.
changes.compatibility: Intel display/blitter work remains bounded native-provider work; Linux i915/Mesa ABI compatibility is not promised.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: All four kernel compiler routes consume one ordered kernel/SOURCES manifest.
changes.rationale: Four hand-maintained lists repeatedly produced route-specific source drift.
changes.compatibility: Every kernel compile route must consume kernel/SOURCES; route-local source lists are unsupported.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Build the bounded document-browser capability while explicitly refusing moving-target Chrome parity.
changes.rationale: Fetcher, parser, box model and bounded scripting have finite contracts and current implementation evidence.
changes.compatibility: The supported browser contract is the explicit bounded compatibility ledger, not Chrome pixel/API parity.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Replace the false-green aggregate application check with exact manifest, route and lifecycle evidence.
changes.rationale: The old aggregate printed Maze missing while still returning success.
changes.compatibility: Application identities and routes must match the generated manifest; blank or dead catalogue IDs are invalid.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Never promote one artifact or route from another route's runtime or physical evidence.
changes.rationale: Similar names and parent/payload relationships do not prove the exact bytes executed on another route.
changes.compatibility: A receipt applies only to the exact artifact and route it names.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Label Intel modeset writes as host-harness proved and boot-unreachable until a native kernel caller and receipt exist.
changes.rationale: The real driver can light the panel from the harness, but no kernel path arms it.
changes.compatibility: Intel host-harness modesetting is not native-boot display compatibility.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Block public release while build inputs lack an established repository redistribution grant.
changes.rationale: Source possession and successful builds do not create a distribution license.
changes.compatibility: No public redistribution channel is supported until licensing authority exists.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Call the deterministic archive exact build-input recovery, not signed/off-host/whole-repository custody.
changes.rationale: The archive remains unsigned and in the same uncommitted worktree with zero off-host copies.
changes.compatibility: The local source archive is recovery material, not a signed/off-host repository release.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Dependency verification checks exact invoked/resolved bytes and never silently refreshes the lock.
changes.rationale: PATH aliases, package upgrades and firmware drift must make the gate red until inspected.
changes.compatibility: Tool or firmware byte drift requires an inspected lock refresh; silent compatibility is rejected.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Represent conservative build-identity inputs without active edges as scope-only, never compiled.
changes.rationale: Dropping them hides identity scope; calling them compiled invents reachability.
changes.compatibility: Scope-only inputs affect identity but are not claimed as compiled objects.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Forbid unrestricted full landing gates and require the resource-contained launcher and idle-host doctor.
changes.rationale: Overlapping build/editor/graphics pressure preceded a host freeze and forced shutdown.
changes.compatibility: Uncontained full landing-gate invocation is unsupported on this host.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Prove the event envelope as a host-only single-owner core before changing shipped build identity or claiming an audit service.
changes.rationale: Target integration requires an idle contained rebuild and later per-CPU/IRQ/service ownership.
changes.compatibility: The structured-event core is host-only and provides no shipped event-service ABI yet.

changes.summary: Keep the complete landing gate red/unverified until a contained run finishes and its final receipt is captured.
